Many sequences start with 0 (first_tok 0: 8.9x). The strongest activations come from prefixes like 0 0 u d, b 0 u f, f 0 u f and a 0 2 f, where a 0 is followed by u or 2 and then one of the letters. The feature prefers the first occurrence of the current token. It does not fire on the delimiter or on outputs, except weakly in a few cases. Because it is a lookup-like conjunction over three tokens, a simple predicate gets about 0.5 precision and 0.4 recall. Many weaker activations come from other nearby token combinations.
